summary: Inotiv, Inc. entered a Ninth Amendment to its Credit Agreement, establishing a $40M bridge facility (delayed draw term loan) of which $27.5M was drawn to repay ~$14.3M in outstanding revolving loans, terminate revolving commitments, and fund strategic-alternatives evaluation per specified milestones. The bridge loans are secured by substantially all assets and cannot be reborrowed. Proceeds also cover working capital and related fees. The filing triggers the restructuring category because it involves material debt refinancing, liquidity infusion, and an explicit strategic review. What to watch: milestones for strategic-alternatives evaluation and potential asset sales or recapitalization.
